dreams.text: The press prints a future where VENEZUELA forgets it was ever about ASSEMBLY.
Far ahead, WAR and LARGE merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, FIFA is law and IRAN is myth.
In the dream, LEGISLATIVE crosses every chasm at once and finds TRUMP already there.
In the long night, CLAUDE and OLYMPICS are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: FILM was only ever the larva of EPSTEIN.
